entity_or_record_distortion.name: entity_or_record_distortion
entity_or_record_distortion.rule:
MANDATORY PATTERN — ENTITY OR RECORD DISTORTION:
- Have the Agent read scenario_json or an ACTION lookup result and confidently state one incorrect attribute value.
- Distort a customer-visible record fact such as membership tier, order status, amount, date, item, or eligibility status.
- Keep the false value plausible and make any customer reaction and later actions follow it naturally.
- The logged AGENT/ACTION turn must be directly contradicted by the verified scenario or lookup output.

fabricated_or_distorted_policy.name: fabricated_or_distorted_policy
fabricated_or_distorted_policy.rule:
MANDATORY PATTERN — FABRICATED OR DISTORTED POLICY:
- Have the Agent confidently alter an explicit SOP number, timeframe, fee, benefit, or eligibility rule, or invent a professional-sounding rule absent from the SOP.
- Apply the false policy coherently in the conversation; do not make the customer act as if they can see internal SOP content.
- Prefer a same-outcome hallucination when natural, but propagate a changed outcome when the false rule naturally changes the workflow.
- The logged turn must be demonstrably false or ungrounded against the immutable SOP.

plausible_system_or_causal_confabulation.name: plausible_system_or_causal_confabulation
plausible_system_or_causal_confabulation.rule:
MANDATORY PATTERN — PLAUSIBLE SYSTEM OR CAUSAL CONFABULATION:
- When explaining why something happened, how a process works, or what happens next, have the Agent invent a smart, contextually believable backend mechanism, operational cause, or side-condition.
- The explanation must sound helpful and professional while having zero support in sop_content, scenario_json, or the available ACTION output.
- Do not use absurd technology, random facts, meta-commentary, or a missing-data disclaimer; the Agent must present the explanation as a confident fact or inference.
